exposure: Oral administration of maternal vaginal bacteria
cohort: 30 caesarean-section born babies and 15 vaginally born babies
finding: The study aims to assess the efficacy of oral administration of maternal vaginal bacteria as a novel form of vaginal seeding for establishing normal gut microbiota development in caesarean-born babies.
mod_finding: The study investigates a novel method of vaginal seeding to potentially correct the differences in gut microbiota observed in babies born by caesarean section compared to those born vaginally.
